Maya Patel: Heads-up — we spotted a spike of 401/403 during VPC onboarding for tenants created between 01:40–02:10 UTC. ~41 tenants touched, 8 are high-touch trials that stalled. Investigating root cause and outreach plan. tagging CS ops + eng.

eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260322-142 created · severity P2 · assignee @Jon Ruiz · link: https://internal.incidents/INC-20260322-142

Jon Ruiz: Root cause initial triage: a cert-rotation job rotated client certs but didn't update the auth-proxy CA cache on a subset of nodes. Those nodes rejected token introspection calls. Repro'd in staging.

Jon Ruiz: Quick mitigation we applied at 02:45 UTC — flushed auth-proxy CA cache and forced a graceful restart of the proxy pool. That restored onboarding flows for most tenants. Still verifying edge cases and re-ingests.

Jon Ruiz: Repro steps (for engineers):
```
# token introspection failed with TLS alert
openssl s_client -connect auth-proxy-1.internal:443 -showcerts
# check cached CA on node
cat /var/lib/auth-proxy/ca.pem
# force reload
curl -s -X POST 'http://infra-api.internal/proxy/reload?node=auth-proxy-1'
```

Maya Patel: Can we get a CSV of all affected tenants (tenant id, created_at, plan, CS owner) ready? We need to prioritize outreach: 8 trials + 5 mid-market accounts flagged for renewal risk. Leah can run the customer messaging.

Leah (AM): I'll take trials & the 5 at-risk accounts. Draft outreach below — feedback welcome. We want to be transparent, offer a credit for impacted window, and invite to a troubleshooting office hours session.

Leah (AM): Draft customer note:
'Hello — we experienced a brief onboarding disruption affecting some VPC customers between 01:40–02:10 UTC due to an internal certificate rotation issue. Onboarding was interrupted for a small number of tenants; we've restored services and completed a fix that prevents recurrence. If your onboarding is still blocked please reply and we'll prioritize manual help. As a goodwill gesture we are offering a usage credit for the impacted period and a 1:1 troubleshooting session. — Redwood Inference Support'

Priya Nair: Please add a line reminding customers that no customer data was exposed and that we rotate certs as part of normal ops. Also include a link to the RCAs page once published.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Leah, please segment the email: trials get priority subject line and booking link; enterprise gets tailored note with AM CTA. Send by 12:00 UTC.

Leah (AM): Will do. I'll post draft in #customer-templates for review, and queue sends via Intercom. Sending cadence: trials immediate, enterprise after AM sign-off.

Jon Ruiz: Postmortem notes for RCA (short):
- What happened: automated cert rotation did not propagate CA to in-memory cache on subset of auth-proxy nodes.
- Impact: temporary onboarding failures (401/403) for ~41 tenants across regions. No data loss or exfiltration.
- Root cause: race condition in rotation script when run concurrently with rolling deployments.
- Fixes implemented: atomic rotation lock added to rotation job, CA cache invalidation step added, alerting on token-introspection error rate.
- Next steps: backfill monitoring dashboard, run a one-off audit job to validate CA consistency across nodes, publish full RCA doc.

Priya Nair: For our CS prioritization: Leah, please tag which tenants are trials vs paid vs high-renewal-risk. Add a renewal-risk banner to the renewal tracker so AE/CS leaders can follow-up.

Leah (AM): Added flags in the CSV and pinged AEs. Scheduling two office-hours blocks today (15:00 and 18:00 UTC) for affected customers. I'll include a Calendly link in the outreach.

Maya Patel: Good. Also recommend we proactively extend trial periods by 48 hours for affected trial tenants — reduces churn risk.

Leah (AM): Done. I'll add the 48-hour extension to the outreach template and note the credit. Draft going out now.

Maya Patel: Final ask — once the full RCA doc is ready, let's run a 30-min sync with CS/AE leaders to review talking points for renewal conversations. Thanks team :heart:

eng-oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260322-142 status updated: mitigated at 02:47 UTC; RCA draft in progress.
